description: Rise No.3 is a fictional sparkling-water brand: a Zyqor Studio design concept built with Video Flow, a scroll-scrubbed real-footage page where whole strawberries rise through the water as you scroll.

hero.title: Rise
hero.sub: Whole strawberries, cold water and a lot of bubbles. Scroll, and watch them rise.

beats.title: Whole / berries
beats.body: Whole strawberries steep in cold water for a full day. No syrup, no flavouring, nothing pretending to be fruit.

beats.title: Fine, / slow fizz
beats.body: Small bubbles that lift the fruit instead of drowning it. You taste the berry first, then the sparkle.

beats.title: Zero / added
beats.body: The sweetness is the strawberry's own. Nothing else goes into the can.

beats.title: Ice cold, / always
beats.body: Best at four degrees, straight from the can or poured over a glass of ice.

specs.title: Short list, / on purpose
specs.body: These are specs of a concept drink, not a real product. The page is generated from one config file and one clip of real footage.

strip.title: One take. / {frames} frames.
strip.body: Real slow-motion footage, cut into {frames} frames and drawn to a canvas as you scroll. Tap a frame to send the berries back.

cta.title: Taste / the rise
cta.body: A concept can for a fictional drinks brand. Nothing is for sale; the strawberries are real.
cta.note: Zyqor Lab concept. Fictional brand, real footage.
